title: The Gospel
name: A Heavenly Home
intro: Could you say that you are 100 percent sure that you will go to Heaven when you die? The Bible says...

sections.head: We Have All Sinned.
sections.quote: "For all have sinned, and come short of the glory of God;"
p: The word sin means to fall short or miss the mark. We cannot come to God because of our sin.

sections.head: Sin Has A Penalty.
sections.quote: "For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord."
p: The payment for your sin is death and separation from God in a place that the Bible calls hell.

sections.head: Jesus Paid The Penalty.
sections.quote: "But God commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us."
p: God proved His love for you by giving His Son, Jesus Christ, to die on the cross for your sins.

sections.head: You Can Confess & Believe Today.
sections.quote: "That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved. For whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved."
p: To confess and believe on Jesus Christ simply means to believe that He died for you, paid the price for your sin, and that He is the only way to Heaven. You can express your belief on Jesus by calling on Him in prayer.
